title: Final Specific Heat (a)
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly state C_R = Nk for the case kT >> hbar^2/I.

title: Final Entropy (a)
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly state S_R = Nk(1 + ln(2IkT/hbar^2)) for the case kT >> hbar^2/I.

title: Final Specific Heat (b)
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly state C_R = (3Nh^4)/(I^2kT^2)e^(-h^2/(4pi^2IkT)) for the case kT << hbar^2/I.

title: Final Entropy (b)
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly state S_R = (3N hbar^2)/(IT)e^(-h^2/(4pi^2IkT)) for the case kT << hbar^2/I.

title: Correct Partition Function
description: Important Criteria: The student must derive the correct expression for the partition function z_R in both limiting cases.

title: Energy Contribution
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly calculate the energy contribution E_R in both limiting cases.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid sign mistakes in the expressions for C_R and S_R.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must ensure that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.
